$comment: Pins the yt-dlp sidecar that Colloquium bundles to resolve a share link (a
YouTube URL) into a playable media URL. Upstream publishes one self-contained
binary per platform, so unlike the ffmpeg sidecars there is nothing to build:
the checksums below are the ones in the release's own SHA2-256SUMS file.
To bump: pick a release tag, then copy that release's SHA2-256SUMS lines for
the assets named here. yt-dlp ships often, and an extractor that has stopped
working is almost always fixed by moving to a newer tag.
